image_description: A close-up shot of two spoonbills interacting. The primary subject on the left is a Roseate Spoonbill, characterized by pink plumage on the wings and body, white neck, and a distinctive long, flat, spatulate bill with a greyish base and pale tip. It has a visible orange eye and greenish facial skin. The secondary subject on the right is likely a Eurasian or African Spoonbill, featuring predominantly white plumage and a yellowish-orange bill with a black tip. The background is a soft-focus green foliage.
